attr.title: Twill Studio
attr.desc: A groovebox for handhelds. Write songs in a piano roll with synths built on Emilie Gillet's open-source eurorack code (MIT) and sampler kits, arrange clips, automate sounds and effects, mix, and render to WAV. Plays along with USB MIDI keyboards and synths.
attr.inst: Ready to run, no additional files needed. Your own WAV samples go in ports/twill/samples.
